main_text.head: OBSERVATIONES IN ANNOTATIONES GUILLELMI BEVEREGII IN CANONES APOSTOLICOS.
main_text.p: GUILLELMUS BEVEREGIUS qui I.[?] Pandectas Canonum SS. Apostolorum & Conciliorum ab Ecclesiâ Græcâ receptorum, necnon Canonicarum SS. Patrum Epistolarum, magno reipublicæ litterariæ bono, nuper edidit, Canones illos, imprimis Apostolicos eruditissimis illustrare dignatus est observationibus, in quibus haud vulgarem viri docti & in hoc litterarum genere non sine laude versati, cernere est eruditionem. Etsi meo quidem judicio plura scripserit quæ omnium forsan eruditorum palato non sunt sapitura; Ab illis tamen examinandis ac refellendis lubens abstinuissem, ni Beveregius iisdem cum Pearsonio permotus rationibus, Dallæum nostrum fœlicis recordationis virum, etde Ecclesiâ Dei optimè meritum adortus ef-

page.notes: The drop cap C is joined to "UILLELMUS", read as GUILLELMUS. The marginal mark beside "qui" looks like "I." but is slightly blurred, so it is marked [?]. The word "etde" is printed as such (probably "est" with a line break error in the scan); left as printed. The line "adortus ef-" is hyphenated and continues on the next page with "est". The "I." marginal mark is a section marker.
